text: Sanborn likes 'spatial systems'. The copper's oddities, its question marks, the letter missing from K2, the raised YAR, the extra L, the odd line lengths, sit at particular places, which could be the number half of a key.
Their places, lines and columns as numbers repeated from every start, added or subtracted, with a secret word of 1-24 letters on 12 table rules; the 24 known letters must agree on the word.
Nothing fits K4 or any of 20 scrambled copies; a planted text is found. F4.3 closed.
